sahneler.metin: Hurricane Sandy's storm surge hit New York City.
Suddenly seawater flooded streets, tunnels and subway lines.
The surge reached about thirteen feet.
Road tunnels had to be closed.
Power was cut across the city.
Sea level had risen over the past century.
That made the surge reach further.
New York began major resilience projects.

aciklama:
Sandy flooded New York's tunnels and subway. The cause: surge water pouring into low-lying tunnels, subway lines and power infrastructure.
